status: post-hoc diagnostic; not independent confirmation or replacement of main results
hypothesis: Reducing only the late learning rate can prevent the observed last-500-update loss of already-acquired finite-rule accuracy.
selection_reason: These three observed cases had high accuracy at3500 and lower accuracy at4000; deliberately outcome-selected, so not an unbiased efficacy estimate.
paired_control: Replay exactly4000 updates at lr0.01 from saved initial weights and the same master input stream, retaining AdamW moments; require byte-exact equality with original final payload.
intervention: Replay from same initialization with lr0.01 through3500, change only lr to0.001 for3501..4000. No optimizer reset, no weight-decay change, no new data.
checks: Initial-through3500 snapshot bytes match in both branches. Control4000 matches original. Recompute every final quality. Report all three intervention outcomes without changing main gates.
